description: List contacts in the user's Keepsake CRM. Supports pagination, sorting, field selection (use `fields` to skip long notes when scanning many contacts), filters on linked companies and on last update, and optional last_interaction_date enrichment. Each contact's companies are company records, returned in `companies`.

company.description: Only contacts linked to this company: a company UUID, or part of its name (case and accents ignored)

fields.description: Only return these fields (id is always included). Columns: first_name, last_name, email, phone, job_title, address, birth_day, birth_month, birth_year, notes, created_at, updated_at. Computed: companies, last_interaction_date. Omit for everything.

has_company.description: true: only contacts linked to at least one company; false: only contacts without any company

include_last_interaction.description: Include last_interaction_date for each contact (default: false)

sort.description: Sort field: last_name, first_name, created_at, updated_at

updated_since.description: Only contacts updated after this ISO date or timestamp

name: list_contacts
